The original three CC0 nature recordings: birds by kvgarlic, stream by gluckose, wind by felix.blume. Full sources and processing are in credits.json.

NEW BACKGROUND RECORDINGS — full rollout
Prepared on 2026-10-25. The three approved pilot backgrounds are unchanged.
Each file is a separate quiet loop intended beneath spoken guidance.

rain: rain ambience
Author: alex36917
License: CC BY 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Original: https://freesound.org/people/alex36917/sounds/524605/
Downloaded from: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rafaelmardojai/blanket/master/data/resources/sounds/rain.ogg
Previous edit: Porrumentzio (Blanket)
Local changes: Selected interval; 120 Hz high-pass, 6000 Hz low-pass, gentle peak compression, -29 LUFS normalization with -13 dB peak limiting, 2 s seamless crossfade, 44.1 kHz stereo 128 kbps MP3 encoding.
Selection: Quiet early rain interval; excludes later thunder and train horn.
Prepared file: audio/nature/rain.mp3
